latest_release.name: v1.13.0
latest_release.body:
## Features

* **http2:** add an executor getter for server and client (#4250) ([b638fc0d](https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/commit/b638fc0de351987f3eaffa2bdabd393c8679a9e8))

## Bug Fixes

* **client:** fail parked h2 request with connection error on close (#4275) ([dea9acb5](https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/commit/dea9acb5344e0e34bb9196f5493464db68edd24a), closes [#4269](https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/issues/4269))
* **http1:**
  * preserve streaming bodies when coercing HTTP/2 requests (#4236) ([21da6a59](https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/commit/21da6a59db9a90631302e7b173c106b723b9065f))
  * prevent `SendRequest` from reporting ready while a request is pending (#4247) ([47c725c4](https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/commit/47c725c459ede66e68ad705f7da9a901abbbdc17), closes [#4246](https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/issues/4246))
  * avoid adding connection-close to 101 responses (#4248) ([ac3f9501](https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/commit/ac3f9501de373388fb9914e285134cfec2283bd8), closes [#4244](https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/issues/4244))
  * error when final body chunk is shorter than content-length (#4270) ([75062064](https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/commit/750620646ba0777daa45be3d82bd1704dcf470b8))
  * drop Content-Length when a response also has Transfer-Encoding (#4264) ([378f8479](https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/commit/378f8479b8b703d098b46de1cec9ea648f12ea69), closes [#4263](https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/issues/4263))
  * drain in-flight requests before dispatcher shutdown (#4222) ([97fff93e](https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/commit/97fff93e53f9e6a993f2d6a25d50883b7b8752a7), closes [#4202](https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/issues/4202))
* **http2:**
  * report zero body size hint for HEAD responses (#4237) ([4e1c0fbb](https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/commit/4e1c0fbb9db68936c952c481321d96f536568283))
  * prevent requests from hanging during concurrent connection shutdown race (#4242) ([5634b91d](https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/commit/5634b91d607ba1b781699765b22f16fd6ec1c8b7))
  * strip all headers named in every Connection header (#4271) ([a44e32a7](https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/commit/a44e32a7f85a1f98e34307ae17985c0bc1349a03))
  * keep connection open after rejecting CONNECT (#4235) ([88520c3e](https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/commit/88520c3eaea391f8ba49591a84f8439998b76191))

## All the PRs
* docs(contrib): minor improvements to HIP-0001 by @seanmonstar in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4227
* fix(http1): drain client dispatch receiver on connection shutdown by @akasakariko in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4222
* chore(ci): check that PR descriptions assert that the words are human by @seanmonstar in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4229
* style(proto): enforce clippy:let_unit_value by @cratelyn in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4231
* style(lib): enforce clippy::redundant_closure_for_method_calls by @trivikr in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4251
* style(lib): enforce clippy::trivially_copy_pass_by_ref by @trivikr in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4252
* style(lib): enforce clippy::unnested_or_patterns by @trivikr in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4256
* fix(ci): deny warnings in 'features' step by @cratelyn in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4253
* feat(http2): add an executor getter for server and client by @robertream in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4250
* fix(http1): drop Content-Length when a response also has Transfer-Encoding by @kevin9327 in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4264
* fix(http2): keep connection open after rejecting CONNECT by @shuvroroy in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4235
* chore(github): add human authorship checkbox to issue templates by @seanmonstar in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4267
* fix(http2): strip headers named in every Connection header by @patrick-immometrica in https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/pull/4271
* perf(http1): read chunk f

# [hyper](https://hyper.rs)

[![crates.io](https://img.shields.io/crates/v/hyper.svg)](https://crates.io/crates/hyper)
[![Released API docs](https://docs.rs/hyper/badge.svg)](https://docs.rs/hyper)
[![MIT licensed](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](./LICENSE)
[![CI](https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/workflows/CI/badge.svg)](https://github.com/hyperium/hyper/actions?query=workflow%3ACI)
[![Discord chat][discord-badge]][discord-url]

A protective and efficient HTTP library for all.

- HTTP/1 and HTTP/2
- Asynchronous design
- Leading in performance
- Tested and **correct**
- Extensive production use
- Client and Server APIs

**Get started** by looking over the [guides](https://hyper.rs/guides/1/).

## "Low-level"

hyper is a relatively low-level library, meant to be a building block for
libraries and applications.

If you are looking for a convenient HTTP client, then you may wish to consider
[reqwest](https://github.com/seanmonstar/reqwest).

If you are not sure what HTTP server to choose, then you may want to consider
[axum](https://github.com/tokio-rs/axum) or
[warp](https://github.com/seanmonstar/warp), the latter taking a more functional
approach. Both are built on top of this library.

## Contributing

To get involved, take a look at [CONTRIBUTING](CONTRIBUTING.md).

If you prefer chatting, there is an active community in the [Discord server][discord-url].
